## Meet Trish.
#### Business Owner, Community Leader, Animal Advocate
I believe that effective community leadership starts with genuinely listening to the people you serve, understanding their concerns, and taking meaningful action. As a business owner and advocate for my community, I recognize how crucial it is to support strong local businesses and promote responsible leadership, ensuring that residents feel heard and represented in Concord. This commitment is central to my vision as I pursue a position on the Trish Brazil Concord City Council.
My goal is to build a brighter future for Concord by investing in vital areas such as safer, better-maintained roads and infrastructure, a thriving local economy, and the thoughtful development of the Concord Naval Weapons Station. Most importantly, I aim to keep Concord connected, ensuring that residents from all walks of life have a voice in shaping our city’s future.
As an advocate for animal welfare, I am dedicated to addressing Concord’s growing pet overpopulation issue. Through my work with Stitch in Time Animal Rescue (STAR), I bring affordable spay and neuter resources to pet owners throughout Concord and Contra Costa County. This animal advocacy initiative helps prevent unwanted litters, keeps pets with their families, and alleviates the burden on local shelters and rescue organizations.
People, pets, and community are at the core of what motivates me—these are the bedrocks of the future I envision for Concord. Together, we can make a substantial impact in our city as I aspire to serve on the Concord City Council.

# Endorse Trish.
I’m running for Concord City Council because I believe in the power of strong leadership, community involvement, and putting People. Pets. Community. first. If you share my vision for a stronger Concord, I’d be honored to have your endorsement. Add your name below and join the growing list of people supporting my campaign.*
Endorse Trish
### Dr. Brazil knows how to get things done.
-Len Welsh, Campaign Manager
Read More
## This is the first candidate I've seen who talks about community and wanting to change things for the better that I believe. And her work with animals as well as the hurricane Katrina victims speaks volumes about her character. We could use some of that character in every part of politics.
-Carissa Jackson, Supporter
## Trish takes action! Identifying needs, brainstorming ideas and looking for solutions. She does not wait and hope someone else will take care of it. Trish is a doer, passionate about ensuring the city she lives in is doing the very best for its residents, businesses, and environment.
-Lisa and Gary Taylor, Supporters
## Trish is a mover and shaker. Her words have meaning and she follows through on any given task. Trish gets the job done! She is thoughtful, sincere & community based. A strong kind human, she respect others and animal alike. I highly support Trish Brazil for City Council.
-Suzy Grant, Supporter
## Trish is smart, dedicated, resourceful and driven! She would be an asset to Concord’s city council!! She has my vote, for sure!!!
-David Carley, Supporter
## I met Trish 33 years ago when we were working on our Internships to complete our graduate degrees. She always amazed me with her boundless energy, compassion for people and pets and her drive to make things better. She will make change happen!
-Marcella Thompson, Longtime Friend
## Trish brings integrity and a sincere desire to serve the residents of Concord. She will work tirelessly to represent the voices of her community and will always remain accessible to the people she serves.
-Traci White, Owner Visual Sound Solutions
## Trish is very knowledgable regarding matters concerning the citizens of Concord and is ethical, methodical, and informed in her decision making. Those qualities combined with her passion for her community and boundless energy to get things done make her your best candidate for your city council.
-Linda Manatte, Friend
## Trish is my mom and she's always been there for me regardless of what happened or what I needed.
-Vicki Brazil, Daughter
## Trish's dedication to animal welfare is unmatched. She's a woman of action who shows up for animals and will bring that same commitment to serving the people in her community.
-Shira Steinbeck, Supporter
#### Thank You For Your Endorsement!
